correctness.rationale: Forcing chains yield leaf necessity and a unique center force; seeded components of zero rim sites are characterized exactly by successive 00 defect edges; an unseeded component needs the unique hub force and hence must be a singleton arising from a physical 000. The unique 111 permits center activation. A marked defect-11 pair and odd intervening gaps count all cyclic words without overcount, producing 2k sum_{r>=2}(r-1) binom(k-2,2r-3), which equals k^2*2^(k-4) for k>=4, with k=3 checked separately. Full independent finite verification by Python/C++17 checks all balanced leaf candidates through n=20.

value.rationale: The exact cardinality of the natural family of minimum zero forcing configurations on even helms, previously studied for optimum size and propagation time, is a motivated missing invariant. A complete binary local obstruction criterion gives direct membership testing and a simple exact exponential census; optimum configurations are numerous yet local token slides cannot connect any, illustrating a substantive configuration/mobility contrast. This is not just a restatement of the known optimum size.
